title: Three against four — Leave the opening silent in Four and move its two answers
help: Three keeps all three notes. Four keeps only its second and fourth notes, so its own first note is a rest. Offsets zero, one and two move those two answers. A meeting puts two notes at one slot; it does not remove a voice. Use stays silent.
rows: Two answers at the ordinary offset
message: rests experiments keep the supplied choices silent and reversible
facts: Zero-based Three0/4/8. Kept Four indices1/3 mean base slots3/9; after offsets0/1/2 slots3/9,4/10,5/11. Total five notes in every row; occupied slots5/4/5. Only offset1 meets Three at slot4. Native display adds1: meeting is shown at slot5. Do not invent an offset3 or change timing.
